sheets.name: README
rows: Separate bulk RDF/ship-graph execution of frozen SHACL shapes.
This evaluator never calls an LLM and is not part of the generation repair loop.

sheets.name: EVALUATION_RESULTS
rows: Conforms: false | After the applicable deadline, the ship must use the 2017 section 3.2.2 or section 3.2.4 engine-output compliance method.
Conforms: false | Applicable ships require valid delivery and assessment dates to evaluate the compliance deadline.
Conforms: false | The lower ice waterline must contain exactly the minimum intended vertical envelope and no non-envelope profile points.

Conforms: false | A ballast tank above the LIWL and used to reach the LIWL must have freezing prevention.

Conforms: false | For an IA Super or IA ship whose construction stage was before 1 September 2003, delivery and assessment dates are required; from 1 January of the delivery year plus twenty years, the section 3.2.2 compliance method is required.

Conforms: false | For a ship without ice strengthening, regulation and classification scantlings must be comparable; when the regulation value is lower, the selected scantling must be at least the classification value in the same unit.
Conforms: false | A member not normal to the plating requires classification-society section-property calculation evidence.
Conforms: false | The ice-class design parameter set must provide the prescribed level ice thickness and design ice load height in metres.
Conforms: false | Required shell plating thickness does not satisfy the applicable formula within relative tolerance 1e-6 and absolute fallback 1e-12, or the formula domain is invalid.

Conforms: false | Node <urn:nltl:batch01-fixture:TRF-043:fail:component> must conform to one or more shapes in ([ sh:not gen:IceClassIaSuperCondition ] , gen:AboveAtLeast1_2MetreRequirement) and ([ sh:not gen:IceClassIaIbIcCondition ] , gen:AboveAtLeast1_0MetreRequirement) and ([ sh:not [ sh:and ( gen:IceClassIaSuperCondition gen:BowRegionCondition ) ] ] , gen:ReachesTankTopRequirement) and ([ sh:not [ sh:and ( gen:IceClassIaSuperCondition gen:MidbodyRegionCondition ) ] ] , gen:BelowAtLeast2_0MetreRequirement) and ([ sh:not [ sh:and ( gen:IceClassIaSuperCondition gen:SternRegionCondition ) ] ] , gen:BelowAtLeast1_6MetreRequirement) and ([ sh:not [ sh:and ( gen:IceClassIaIbIcCondition gen:BowRegionCondition ) ] ] , gen:BelowAtLeast1_6MetreRequirement) and ([ sh:not [ sh:and ( gen:IceClassIaIbIcCondition gen:MidbodyRegionCondition ) ] ] , gen:BelowAtLeast1_3MetreRequirement) and ([ sh:not [ sh:and ( gen:IceClassIaIbIcCondition gen:SternRegionCondition ) ] ] , gen:BelowAtLeast1_0MetreRequirement) and ([ sh:not [ sh:property [ sh:hasValue Literal("true" = True, datatype=xsd:boolean) ; sh:path nltl:upperBowIceBeltRequired ] ] ] , gen:ReachesUpperBowIceBeltTopRequirement)
Conforms: false | The boundary-condition factor, moment factor, shear factor, section modulus, or required shear area is inconsistent with clause 4.4.2.1.

Conforms: false | The strengthened lower end must use an approved direct attachment or, for an eligible intermediate ice frame, a compliant horizontal connection to two distinct strengthened adjacent main frames.
Conforms: false | The frame inputs, factors, minimum section modulus, effective shear area, boundary-condition evidence, or bracket-exclusion calculation do not satisfy clause 4.4.3.
Conforms: false | The frame web or in-lieu plate thickness is below one or more required lower bounds.

Conforms: false | Node <urn:nltl:batch01-fixture:TRF-053:fail:component> must conform to one or more shapes in [ sh:property [ sh:hasValue Literal("false" = False, datatype=xsd:boolean) ; sh:path nltl:locatedWithinIceBelt ] ] , [ sh:node gen:IceStringerCalculationShape ; sh:property [ sh:hasValue Literal("true" = True, datatype=xsd:boolean) ; sh:path nltl:locatedWithinIceBelt ] ]

Conforms: false | For an outside-belt stringer supporting ice-strengthened frames, design line load, outside-ice-belt factor, section modulus, and required shear area must satisfy clauses 4.13 and 4.14 within relative tolerance 1e-6 or absolute tolerance 1e-9.
Conforms: false | Value is not >= Literal("100.0", datatype=xsd:decimal)
Conforms: false | Required shear area must match sqrt(3) times alpha times f13 times shear force divided by yield strength, within relative tolerance 1e-6 or absolute tolerance 1e-9 cm2.
